---
title: Spryker
description: Privacy rules for Spryker B2B Marketplace 202610 on MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL
---

Covers customers and addresses, orders and their address copies, returns, back-office and company users, merchants, reviews, notes, social-login identities, and Spryker's tokens and secrets.

## Coverage

- **Versions:** B2B Marketplace demo 202610.0.
- **Engines:** MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL.
- **Table prefix:** the template assumes unprefixed table names. Spryker uses no table prefix; its tables start with `spy_` by name.

## Template

```yaml
privacy:
  rules:
    emails:
      columns:
        - spy_customer.email
        - spy_sales_order.email
        - spy_sales_order.agent_email
        - spy_sales_order_address.email
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.email
        - spy_sales_reclamation.customer_email
        - spy_newsletter_subscriber.email
        - spy_availability_notification_subscription.email
        - spy_user.username
        - spy_company_business_unit.email
        - spy_company_user_invitation.email
        - spy_merchant.email
        - spy_merchant_profile.public_email
        - spy_merchant_registration_request.email
        - spy_oauth_knpu_customer_identity.email
        - spy_oauth_knpu_merchant_user_identity.email
        - spy_oauth_knpu_user_identity.email
      entity: EMAIL_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    names:
      columns:
        - spy_customer.first_name
        - spy_customer.last_name
        - spy_customer_address.first_name
        - spy_customer_address.last_name
        - spy_customer_note.username
        - spy_sales_order.first_name

        - spy_sales_order_address.first_name
        - spy_sales_order_address.middle_name
        - spy_sales_order_address.last_name
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.first_name
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.middle_name
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.last_name
        - spy_sales_order_comment.username
        - spy_sales_reclamation.customer_name
        - spy_user.first_name
        - spy_user.last_name
        - spy_company_user_invitation.first_name
        - spy_company_user_invitation.last_name
        - spy_merchant_profile.contact_person_first_name
        - spy_merchant_profile.contact_person_last_name
        - spy_merchant_registration_request.contact_person_first_name
        - spy_merchant_registration_request.contact_person_last_name
        - spy_product_review.nickname
        # Spryker Eco: PunchOut Gateway and Vertex (optional)

      entity: PERSON
      operator: hash
    user-ids:
      columns:
        - spy_oauth_knpu_customer_identity.external_id
        - spy_oauth_knpu_merchant_user_identity.external_id
        - spy_oauth_knpu_user_identity.external_id

      operator: hash
    phones:
      columns:
        - spy_customer.phone
        - spy_customer_address.phone
        - spy_sales_order_address.phone
        - spy_sales_order_address.cell_phone
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.phone
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.cell_phone
        - spy_company_business_unit.phone
        - spy_company_unit_address.phone
        - spy_merchant_profile.contact_person_phone
        - spy_merchant_profile.public_phone
        - spy_merchant_profile.fax_number
        - spy_merchant_registration_request.contact_person_phone

    addresses:

        - spy_customer_address.address2
        - spy_customer_address.address3
        - spy_customer_address.city
        - spy_sales_order_address.address1

        - spy_sales_order_address.address3

        - spy_sales_order_address.po_box

        - spy_sales_order_address_history.address2
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.address3
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.city
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.po_box
        - spy_company_unit_address.address1
        - spy_company_unit_address.address2
        - spy_company_unit_address.address3
        - spy_company_unit_address.city
        - spy_merchant_profile_address.address1
        - spy_merchant_profile_address.address2
        - spy_merchant_profile_address.address3
        - spy_merchant_profile_address.city
        - spy_merchant_profile_address.longitude
        - spy_merchant_profile_address.latitude
        - spy_merchant_registration_request.address1
        - spy_merchant_registration_request.address2

        - spy_sales_order_address_history.description
        - spy_sales_order_address_history.comment
        - spy_sales_order_comment.message
        - spy_sales_return_item.reason
        - spy_company_unit_address.comment
        - spy_merchant_relation_request.request_note
        - spy_merchant_relation_request.decision_note
        - spy_comment.message
        - spy_shopping_list_item_note.note
        - spy_product_review.summary
        - spy_product_review.description
        - spy_ssp_inquiry.subject
        - spy_ssp_inquiry.description
        - spy_ssp_asset.note
      entity: FREE_TEXT
      operator: replace
    passwords:
      columns:
        - spy_customer.password
        - spy_user.password
        - spy_api_key.key_hash
        # Spryker Eco: PunchOut Gateway and Vertex (optional)
        - spy_punchout_credential.password_hash
      entity: PASSWORD_HASH
      operator: redact
    tokens:
      columns:
        - spy_customer.restore_password_key
        - spy_customer.registration_key
        - spy_customer_data_change_request.verification_token
        - spy_auth_reset_password.code
        - spy_newsletter_subscriber.subscriber_key
        - spy_availability_notification_subscription.subscription_key
        - spy_company_user_invitation.hash
        - spy_resource_share.uuid
        # Spryker Eco: PunchOut Gateway and Vertex (optional)
        - spy_punchout_session.session_token
        - spy_punchout_session.buyer_cookie
      entity: AUTH_TOKEN
      operator: redact
    otp-secrets:
      columns:
        - spy_customer_multi_factor_auth_codes.code
        - spy_user_multi_factor_auth_codes.code
      entity: OTP_SECRET
      operator: redact
    secrets:
      columns:
        - spy_oauth_access_token.identifier
        - spy_oauth_refresh_token.identifier
        - spy_oauth_client.secret
        - spy_oauth_client_access_token_cache.access_token
        - spy_vault_deposit.initial_vector
        - spy_vault_deposit.cipher_text
        # Spryker Eco: PunchOut Gateway and Vertex (optional)
        - spy_vertex_api_access_token.access_token
      entity: API_KEY
      operator: redact
    # Optional: mixed-content columns. Ruling them hides their non-personal content too; remove to keep it readable.
    mixed-content:
      columns:
        - spy_oauth_access_token.user_identifier
        - spy_oauth_refresh_token.user_identifier
        - spy_quote.quote_data
        - spy_quote_request_version.quote
        - spy_quote_request_version.metadata
        - spy_sales_order_amendment_quote.quote_data
        - spy_recurring_schedule.quote_data
        - spy_customer_data_change_request.data
        - spy_product_review_search.data
        - spy_product_review_search.structured_data
        - spy_merchant_storage.data
        - spy_merchant_search.data
        - spy_merchant_search.structured_data
        - spy_company_user_storage.data
        - spy_ai_conversation_history.original_messages
        - spy_ai_interaction_log.prompt
        - spy_ai_interaction_log.response
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: replace
    # Keep: mixed-content columns that hold credentials.
    mixed-content-secrets:
      columns:
        - spy_event_behavior_entity_change.data
        - spy_configuration_value.value
        - spy_app_config.config
        - spy_customer_multi_factor_auth.configuration
        - spy_user_multi_factor_auth.configuration
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: redact
```

**Choices**

- `spy_user.username` is the back-office login and must be an e-mail address, so it is `EMAIL_ADDRESS`.
- `spy_resource_share.uuid` opens a shared cart; each multi-factor method's `configuration` holds its secret.
- `spy_merchant_profile_address.longitude` and `latitude` pin the merchant address; `external_id` on `spy_oauth_knpu_*_identity` is the social-login account id.
- Optional parts: delete the Spryker Eco columns if you do not run PunchOut Gateway or Vertex, and the `mixed-content` rule to keep those columns readable; keep `mixed-content-secrets`.
- Projects add tables and columns in their own schema files under `src/Pyz`; add each to the rule for its data type.

## Trade-offs

- **Indexed ruled columns:** `spy_customer.email`, `first_name`, `last_name`; `spy_newsletter_subscriber.email`, `subscriber_key`; `spy_user.username`; `spy_merchant.email`; `spy_company_user_invitation.email`, `hash`; `spy_auth_reset_password.code`; `spy_api_key.key_hash`; `spy_resource_share.uuid`; `spy_availability_notification_subscription.email`, `subscription_key`; `spy_company.name`; `spy_customer_data_change_request.verification_token`; `spy_oauth_refresh_token.identifier`; `spy_merchant_registration_request.email`, `company_name`; `spy_oauth_knpu_*_identity.external_id`; `spy_punchout_credential.username`; `spy_punchout_session.buyer_cookie`, `session_token`.
- **Lookups that stop working:** customers, orders, subscribers, or back-office users by e-mail; orders by city or postcode; shared carts by `uuid`; alerts by unsubscribe key.
- **Join keys that stay unruled:** `id_*` and `fk_*` keys, `customer_reference`, `merchant_reference`, and `order_reference`.
- **B2B data:** company names, business-unit contacts and bank details, and merchant contacts are ruled: in B2B shops they name one person or a sole trader.

## Not covered

- `spy_glossary_translation.value`: merchant imprint and terms, beside every shop text.
- `spy_refund.comment`, `spy_shopping_list.name`, `description`, `spy_quote.name`, `order_custom_reference`: short labels; rule them if yours hold names.
- `spy_sales_order_note.message`, `command`: the state machine's command log.
- `spryker-eco/stripe`, PunchOut `session_data` and `configuration`, Vertex `response_data`: payment ids and integration payloads.
- `spy_stock_address`, `spy_service_point_address`, `spy_merchant.name`, business-unit names: business locations and names.
- `spy_sales_payment_detail.details`, item configuration, other `*_storage` and `*_search` data: payment and catalog metadata.
